test.title: Economic PYQ · Set 08
test.subject: Economics
test.description: English ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು · ಕನ್ನಡ ವಿವರಣೆ · 30 ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು · 30 ನಿಮಿಷ. ಉತ್ತರಗಳು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿದವು; ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಕೀ ದೃಢೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. 3 ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು + 27 ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು.

config.title: KEA PYQ · ECONOMIC PYQ · SET 08
config.scoringBasis: ಸಂದೇಹ ಅಥವಾ ಮೂಲದ ದೋಷವಿರುವ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಂಕವಿಲ್ಲ. ಉಳಿದ ಉತ್ತರಗಳು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿದವು; ಅಧಿಕೃತ answer key ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ದೃಢೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.

questions.question: Q34. BIMSTEC stands for
options: Bay of International Maritime Security Trade Economic Cooperation
Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation
Border Initiative of Maritime and Trade Economic Cooperation
Bengal International Strategic Trade and Economic Council
questions.explanation: BIMSTEC ಎಂದರೆ Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation.

questions.question: Q35. Match the following organisations with reports/index produced by them: Organisations. Reports /Index A. Real Estate regulation authority. Global Real Estate Transparency Index B. NITI Aayog. SATH-E Report. Systemic Transformation of school Education C. IMF. Global Trade Outlook and Statistics D. World Bank. Global Economic Prospects Which of the following is/are correctly matched?
questions.explanation: SATH-E ವರದಿ NITI Aayogಗೆ ಮತ್ತು Global Economic Prospects ವಿಶ್ವ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ; Global Trade Outlook WTO ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆ.

questions.question:
Q6. Consider the following statements about the Global Innovation Index :
1. It was launched in 2007.
2. India has moved up from 81st rank in 2015 to 38th rank in 2025.
3. India, Bangladesh and Indonesia are the top three innovation economies in the category of Lower Middle Income Group as per the Global Innovation Index Report, 2025.
4. France, Germany and the United States of America are the top three innovation economies in the category of High Income Group as per the Global Innovation Index Report, 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: GII 2007ರಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಯಿತು; 2025ರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ 38ನೇ ಸ್ಥಾನ. Lower-middle-income ಮುಂಚೂಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ, Vietnam ಮತ್ತು Philippines ಇದ್ದವು; Bangladesh ಮತ್ತು Indonesia ಅಲ್ಲ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
30. In which economy do consumers and producers make choices based on market forces of supply and demand?
questions.explanation: Market economyಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯ ಬೆಲೆ ಸಂಕೇತಗಳು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.
questions.reference: Day 1 PYQ, Q30, p.10; Day 1 Economy Notes, Q30, p.28

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q19. Consider the following statements :
1. Services sector contributes more than 50% to India's GVA
2. Services sector growth is more volatile than agriculture sector
3. FDI in services sector contributes to three-fourth of total FDI in the post-Covid period
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: Economic Survey 2025-26 ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಸೇವೆಗಳ GVA ಪಾಲು 50% ಮೀರಿದೆ; ಸೇವೆಗಳು ಕೃಷಿಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ volatile; FY23–FY25ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳ FDI ಪಾಲು ಸರಾಸರಿ 80.2%.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
5. Which among the following steps is most likely to be taken at the time of an economic recession?
options: Cut in tax rates accompanied by an increase in interest rates.
Increase in expenditure on public projects.
Increase in tax rates accompanied by a reduction of interest rates.
Reduction of expenditure on public projects.
questions.explanation: ಮಂದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳ ಮೇಲಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿದರೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಬೆಂಬಲ ಸಿಗಬಹುದು.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
16. The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act of India became effective from
questions.explanation: FRBM Act 2003 ಜಾರಿಗೆ ಬಂದದ್ದು 2004ರಲ್ಲಿ; ಕಾಯ್ದೆ ಅಂಗೀಕಾರದ ವರ್ಷ ಮತ್ತು ಜಾರಿ ವರ್ಷ ಬೇರೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
25. Consider the following actions by the Government:
1. Cutting the tax rates
2. Increasing the government spending
3. Abolishing the subsidies In the context of economic recession, which of the above actions can be considered a part of the ‘fiscal stimulus’ package?
questions.explanation: ಮಂದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಕಡಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜನ ನೀಡುವ fiscal stimulus ಕ್ರಮಗಳು.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q22. India's fiscal deficit widens significantly due to increased Government spending on subsidies while tax revenue remains unchanged. Which one of the following is the most likely consequence?
options: Inflation will rise, interest rates will fall, and private investment will increase
Inflation will rise, interest rates may rise, and private investment may slow down
Inflation will fall, interest rates will rise, and private investment will increase
Inflation will fall, interest rates will fall, and GDP growth will accelerate
questions.explanation: ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿಯಿಂದ ಕೊರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಲದ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಏರಿದರೆ ಕೆಲವು ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದರಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಒತ್ತಡ, ಬೆಲೆ ಏರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಖಾಸಗಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ನಿಧಾನಗತಿ ಸಂಭವಿಸಬಹುದು.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
38. Consider the following statements regarding GST council:
(A) Union Finance Minister is the Chairman of the council.
(B) Voting power of States' representatives collectively constitute 2/3rd.
(C) Council meetings proceed only when 50% quorum is there.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: GST Council ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಹಣಕಾಸು ಸಚಿವರು; ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮತಭಾರ 2/3; ಒಟ್ಟು ಸದಸ್ಯರ ಅರ್ಧದಷ್ಟು quorum.
questions.reference: Day 1 PYQ, Q38, p.12; Day 1 Economy Notes, Q38, p.30

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
5. Which one of the following statements is an appropriate description of deflation ?
options: It is a sudden fall in the value of a currency against other currencies
It is a pertinent recession in both the financial and real sectors of the economy
It is a persistent fall in the general price levels of goods and services
It is a fall in the rate of inflation over a period of time
questions.explanation: Deflation ಎಂದರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಲೆಮಟ್ಟ ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಕುಸಿಯುವುದು; ಹಣದುಬ್ಬರದ ವೇಗ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುವುದು disinflation.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q31. The practice of reducing the size of a product while maintaining its sticker price is called:
questions.explanation: ಬೆಲೆ ಅದೇ ಇಟ್ಟು ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್‌ನ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ shrinkflation; ಪ್ರತಿ ಘಟಕದ ನೈಜ ಬೆಲೆ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
9. In India, the central bank’s function as the ‘lender of last resort’ usually refers to which of the following:
1.Lending to trade and industry bodies when they fail to borrow from other sources. 2.Providing liquidity to the banks having a temporary crisis.
3.Lending to governments to finance budgetary deficits.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation: Lender of last resort ಆಗಿ RBI ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ದ್ರವ್ಯತೆ ತೊಂದರೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ನೆರವು ಒದಗಿಸಬಹುದು.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q1. Which one of the following activities of the Reserve Bank of India is considered to be part of ‘sterilization?
options: Oversight of settlement and payment systems
Debt and cash management for the Central and State Governments
Regulating the functions of Non-banking Financial Institutions
questions.explanation: Sterilisationನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದೇಶಿ ವಿನಿಮಯ ಹಸ್ತಕ್ಷೇಪದಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾದ ದ್ರವ್ಯತೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮವನ್ನು RBI open market operations ಮೂಲಕ ತಗ್ಗಿಸಬಹುದು.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q33. To implement a contractionary monetary policy, RBI should not do which of the following? A. Increase the Statutory Liquidity Ratio. B. Decrease the Marginal Standing Facility Rate. C. Cut the Bank Rate and Repo Rate. How many above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: ಸಂಕೋಚನ ನೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ MSF, bank rate ಮತ್ತು repo rate ಕಡಿತ ಮಾಡುವುದು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಕ್ರಮ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
2. Supply of money remaining the same when there is an increase in demand for money, there will be
options: a fall in the level of prices
an increase in the rate of interest
a decrease in the rate of interest
an increase in the level of income and employment
questions.explanation: ಹಣದ ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಹಣದ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಬಡ್ಡಿದರ ಏರಲು ಒತ್ತಡ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
19. In India, the interest rate on savings accounts in all the nationalized commercial banks is fixed by
questions.explanation: ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಠೇವಣಿ ಬಡ್ಡಿದರವನ್ನು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗಳು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ RBI ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
16. Which of the following grants/grant direct credit assistance to rural households?
(1). Regional Rural Banks
(2). National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
(3). Land Development Banks
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
questions.explanation: Regional Rural Banks ಮತ್ತು Land Development Banks ನೇರ ಸಾಲ ನೀಡಬಹುದು; NABARD ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿ refinance ಮತ್ತು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q6. Which one of the following best describes the term “Merchant Discount Rate” sometimes seen in news?
options: The incentive given by a bank to a merchant for accepting payments through debit cards pertaining to that bank.
The amount paid back by banks to their customers when they use debit cards for financial transactions for purchasing goods or services.
The charge to a merchant by a bank for accepting payments from his customers through the bank’s debit cards.
The incentive given by the Government to merchants for promoting digital payments by their customers through Point of Sale (PoS) machines and debit cards.
questions.explanation: Merchant Discount Rate ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್/card ಪಾವತಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವ merchantನಿಂದ ವಿಧಿಸಲಾಗುವ ಸೇವಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q44. With reference to different Committees in India, consider the following details: Sl Committee                     Objective                              Organization under which it No                                                                      was formed 1  R.N. Malhotra Committee       Insurance Comprehensive reforms        Insurance Regulatory and of sector in India.                    Development Authority of India. 2    L.C. Gupta | Committee.      Preparing a roadmap for the           Securities and Exchange introduction of derivatives trading   Board of India. in India. 3      Urjit R. Patel Committee.  Preparing a roadmap for reforming     Reserve Bank of India. bank lending to the Housing sector. 4      Y.H. Malegam Committee. Preparing a roadmap for reforms in       Reserve Bank of India. Microfinance sector in India. In which of the above rows are all the details correctly matched ?
questions.explanation: L. C. Gupta ಸಮಿತಿ SEBI derivatives ಪರಿಚಯಕ್ಕೆ; Malegam ಸಮಿತಿ RBI microfinanceಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ. Malhotra ಸಮಿತಿ IRDAI ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಗೂ ಮೊದಲು ರಚನೆಯಾಯಿತು; Urjit Patel ಸಮಿತಿ monetary policyಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q19. Consider the following statements:
Statement I: As regards returns from an investment in a company, generally, bondholders are considered to be relatively at lower risk than stockholders.
Statement II: Bondholders are lenders to a company whereas stockholders are its owners.
Statement III: For repayment purpose, bondholders are prioritized over stockholders by a company.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
options: Both Statement II and Statement III are correct and both of them explain Statement I
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement I explains Statement II
Only one of the Statements II and III is correct and that explains Statement I
Neither Statement II nor Statement III is correct
questions.explanation: Bondholders ಸಾಲದಾತರು, shareholders ಮಾಲೀಕರು; ಕಂಪನಿ ವಿಸರ್ಜನೆ ಅಥವಾ ಪಾವತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಲದಾತರಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಆದ್ಯತೆ ಇದೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q29. Consider the following statements:
Statement I: Treasury Bills are called Zero Coupon Securities.
Statement II: Treasury Bills are issued by the State Governments in India on a Zero Rate basis.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II is correct explanation of Statement I
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct, but Statement II does not explain Statement I
Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect
Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct
questions.explanation: Treasury bills zero-coupon ಆಗಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪರವಾಗಿ RBI ಮೂಲಕ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತವೆ; ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು T-bills ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
39. Which of the following forms the part of RBI's forex reserves?
(A) Foreign Currency Assets
(B) Gold
(C) Reserve position in IMF
(D) Special drawing rights in IMF
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: ವಿದೇಶಿ ಕರೆನ್ಸಿ ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳು, ಚಿನ್ನ, SDR ಮತ್ತು IMF reserve position ವಿದೇಶಿ ವಿನಿಮಯ ಮೀಸಲಿನ ಭಾಗಗಳು.
questions.reference: Day 1 PYQ, Q39, p.12; Day 4 Economy Notes, Q39, p.44

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q1. Which of the following constitute Capital Account?
(1). Foreign Loans
(2). Foreign Direct Investment
(3). Private Remittances
(4). Portfolio Investment
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
questions.explanation: ವಿದೇಶಿ ಸಾಲ, FDI ಮತ್ತು portfolio investment ಬಂಡವಾಳ/ಹಣಕಾಸು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ; ಖಾಸಗಿ remittances current accountಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q42. India and New Zealand concluded a Free Trade Agreement in 2025-26, under which New Zealand will implement agricultural productivity action plans (innovation) in India for which of the following products?
(a) Kiwifruit
(b) Apple
(c) Honey
(d) Mango
Select the correct answer
questions.explanation: India-New Zealand FTA ಕೃಷಿ productivity action plans: kiwifruit, apples ಮತ್ತು honey.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
27. Consider the following statements and choose the correct answer. Public Distribution System (PDS) of Food Corporation of India addresses the following objectives.
(a) Price control and regulation
(b) Fixation of minimum support price for selected food crops
(c) Maintaining minimum nutritional and consumptional needs of population
(d) Buffer stock
questions.explanation: PDS ಆಹಾರ ವಿತರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಲೆ ಸ್ಥಿರತೆಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; FCI buffer stock ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. MSP ನಿಗದಿ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಕೆಲಸ, PDS ಸ್ವತಃ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
26. Disguised unemployment generally means
options: large number of people remain unemployed
marginal productivity of labour is zero
questions.explanation: Disguised unemploymentನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದರೂ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಣನೀಯ ಕುಸಿತವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ಅವರ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q14. Which one of the following Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) talks about protecting and restoring terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably managing forests, combating desertification, halting and reversing land degradation and stopping biodiversity loss?
questions.explanation: SDG 15 'Life on Land': ಭೂ ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, ಅರಣ್ಯ, ಜೀವವೈವಿಧ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಭೂಕ್ಷಯ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ.

questions.question:
[ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ / REVISION]
Q27. What has been the primary focus of India's economic policy since the 1991 economic liberalization?
options: Promoting export-led growth and foreign investment
Reducing poverty and inequality through social welfare programmes
Achieving the objectives of the Directive Principles of State Policy
Encouraging domestic consumption of imported goods.
questions.explanation: 1991 ನಂತರದ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು ಉದಾರೀಕರಣ, ವಿದೇಶಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜಾಗತಿಕ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಪಾಲ್ಗೊಳ್ಳುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಒತ್ತು ನೀಡಿದವು.

questions.question:

Q36. An e-commerce revenue model where the seller has control over pricing but doesn't keep products in stock and instead transfers customer orders and shipment details to a third-party supplier, who then ships the goods directly to the customer, is called:
questions.explanation: Dropshippingನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರ stock ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳದೆ, supplierನಿಂದ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಗ್ರಾಹಕನಿಗೆ ಸರಕು ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
